risks.reasoning: For the four months ended July 31, 2021, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash generated from operating activities of HK$13,553 thousand and cash and cash equivalents of HK$64,164 thousand. Because net cash from operating activities is positive, the frozen protocol rule treats the period as having no operating cash burn.

The accountants' report shows profit and total comprehensive income attributable to owners of the Company of HK$30,039 thousand, HK$26,387 thousand, HK$35,769 thousand, HK$8,547 thousand and HK$5,149 thousand for the three years ended March 31, 2021 and the four-month periods ended July 31, 2020 and 2021 respectively. There are zero comparable loss periods.

Revenue increased from HK$65,448 thousand in the four months ended July 31, 2020 to HK$78,398 thousand in the same period of 2021, an increase of approximately 19.79%. The latest comparable growth is positive and does not trigger the frozen negative-growth thresholds.

The patient base is highly diversified and the revenue derived from the top five patients accounted for less than 1.3% of total revenue during the Track Record Period. The frozen concentration thresholds are not approached.

The special rights granted to Clear Lead and WuXi AppTec under the Shareholders Agreement consist of nomination, anti-dilution, information, participation, transfer restriction and co-sale rights; no redemption, repurchase or put right was disclosed. The Shareholders Agreement and all special rights terminate upon consummation of the Listing, and the formal disclosure identifies no restoration condition.

The formal Legal Proceedings and Complaints section discloses one prior legal proceeding against Dr. Lau and Saintford that was settled in December 2019 on a without-admission-of-liability basis and fully covered by professional indemnity insurance. It also states that, save as disclosed, the Group was not engaged in litigation or claims of material importance and no material litigation was pending or threatened. Complaints were settled and none remained outstanding.

The Group is an established Hong Kong private ophthalmic healthcare institution with substantial revenue from refractive treatments and other ophthalmic services throughout the Track Record Period. Its services are already commercialized and revenue-generating; it is not a precommercial product-development issuer.

evidence.exact_text: Prior to the Track Record Period, there was a legal proceeding brought by a patient against Dr. Lau and Saintford in November 2016. The legal proceeding was in relation to complications alleged to be suffered by the patient following an ICL surgery performed by Dr. Lau in November 2013. On 19 December 2019, a consent order was given by the High Court of Hong Kong and it was ordered that all further proceedings shall be stayed upon satisfaction of the terms of settlement agreed between the patient and Dr. Lau and Saintford. It was agreed between the patient and Dr. Lau and Saintford that a settlement sum of HK$3.8 million shall be paid to the patient in full and final settlement of all claims from the patient, on a without admission of liability basis.
evidence.evidence_reason: The formal legal proceedings disclosure proves the prior proceeding was fully settled and stayed rather than pending.
